notes: Stories refined for clearer contract boundaries and UI rendering expectations; no new IDs created.

change_log.value: Define and enforce frontend contract for provider distance fields (distance_miles:number, distance_text:string) within structured chat payload segments, ensuring compatibility with markdown-rendered MessageBubble and future extensibility.
change_log.note: Clarify structured payload expectation and markdown coexistence

change_log.value: Implement client-side formatting logic to normalize backend distance values into consistent display strings (rounded miles, unit standardization, null-safe fallback, and threshold handling such as '<1 mi').
Enhance MessageBubble to render formatted distance inline with provider entries (adjacent to name/address) without breaking markdown rendering, spacing, or accessibility.
Ensure distance values from MAINT-DIST propagate through find_care_facade and tool_router into chat response payloads, matching the frontend contract exactly with no schema drift or loss.
Add unit and UI tests validating distance formatting, rendering in MessageBubble, contract compliance, threshold cases, and graceful handling of missing or malformed values.
